_doc: Single calibration source (I06). Default until co-location [S11.2] fits kappa/R_dust. ADR 0007.
kappa_source: spec [S06.4] default; Delhi HTDMA kappa 0.05-0.56 (Mandariya et al. 2024 ACP), PM1 0.13-0.77 (Arub et al. 2020) - fit on co-location
R_dust_source: spec default 1.5 is unreachable for SPS30 (coarse invisible; dust-storm PM10/PM2.5 ~1.6, Gautam et al. 2025) - tune on co-location
